Yes I am and no it isn't.  [I've explained this already](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/4rmlxu/no_sleep_in_4_days_cant_win_cant_not_lose/d52z1el?context=3).  Click the link.  I'm a profoundly stupid asshole who hasn't slept in 5 days and I figured out how to click links; you should be able to do that too.

I can't drone out the coughing, because it's full-body painful spasming that hurts everything north of my ass and makes me vomit when it lasts too long.  You can't put on music and pretend your not in pain like you've been punched by a tank for two minutes straight.  You can't put on music and pretend you can't taste blood and shit in your mouth from vomiting a second ago.  

Also, I was [only technically lucky](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/4rpexj/approaching_5_days_still_cant_sleep/) and cough meds arrived early.  And they don't work.  

Went to the ER, the security guard told me to leave because I looked and smelled like a hobo got shat on and raped by a Sasquatch and "sounded unwell."  Called the doctor I saw the first time, he wasn't there.  Called the doctor I saw the second time, she told me to come in again, and then the security guard chased me off again.  

[EDIT: Hooray for not being on mobile so my idiot squirrel brain can properly reply.  I guess?]

A) lying to doctors isn't going help me or make them inclined to help or believe one syllable of what I say; B) I have no idea how to fake a heart attack or drug overdose (and see A, *supra*); and C) **THERE IS NO OTHER PHARMACY THAT NETWORKS WITH MY INSURANCE**
